title: He never left the hotel
setting: A Sunday afternoon outside their homes. Yuki runs into Satou-san, the elderly neighbour, wheeling a suitcase, and assumes he is just setting off.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: a, satou-san, konnichiwa. kore kara ryokou ni iku n desu ka?
lines.ja: あ、佐藤さん、こんにちは。これから旅行に行くんですか？
lines.kana: あ、さとうさん、こんにちは。これからりょこうにいくんですか？
lines.english: Oh, hello, Satou-san! Are you off on a trip?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: iie, ima kaette kita n desu yo. mukashi kara no tomodachi to, hokkaidou ni ryokou ni itte kimashita.
lines.ja: いいえ、今帰ってきたんですよ。昔からの友達と、北海道に旅行に行ってきました。
lines.kana: いいえ、いまかえってきたんですよ。むかしからのともだちと、ほっかいどうにりょこうにいってきました。
lines.english: No, I've just got back. I went on a trip to Hokkaido with some friends I've known for years.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: hokkaidou! ii desu ne. hikouki de itta n desu ka?
lines.ja: 北海道！いいですね。飛行機で行ったんですか？
lines.kana: ほっかいどう！いいですね。ひこうきでいったんですか？
lines.english: Hokkaido! How lovely. Did you fly?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: hai, hisashiburi ni hikouki ni norimashita. demo, notte sugu nechatta n desu yo.
lines.ja: はい、久しぶりに飛行機に乗りました。でも、乗ってすぐ寝ちゃったんですよ。
lines.kana: はい、ひさしぶりにひこうきにのりました。でも、のってすぐねちゃったんですよ。
lines.english: Yes, my first time on a plane in ages. But I fell asleep the moment I got on.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: wakarimasu. watashi mo hikouki ni noru to, sugu nechau n desu.
lines.ja: わかります。私も飛行機に乗ると、すぐ寝ちゃうんです。
lines.kana: わかります。わたしもひこうきにのると、すぐねちゃうんです。
lines.english: I know the feeling. I always nod off as soon as I'm on a plane, too.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: sorede ne, onsen no aru hoteru ni tomatta n desu. totemo ii hoteru deshita yo.
lines.ja: それでね、温泉のあるホテルに泊まったんです。とてもいいホテルでしたよ。
lines.kana: それでね、おんせんのあるホテルにとまったんです。とてもいいホテルでしたよ。
lines.english: Anyway, we stayed at a hotel with a hot spring. It was a really lovely hotel.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: ii naa. onsen ni wa nando mo haitta n desu ka?
lines.ja: いいなあ。温泉には何度も入ったんですか？
lines.kana: いいなあ。おんせんにはなんどもはいったんですか？
lines.english: Lucky you. Did you get in the hot spring a lot?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: hai, asa mo hiru mo yoru mo. kimochi yokatta desu yo.
lines.ja: はい、朝も昼も夜も。気持ちよかったですよ。
lines.kana: はい、あさもひるもよるも。きもちよかったですよ。
lines.english: Oh yes, morning, noon and night. It felt wonderful.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: hoka ni wa, doko ni itta n desu ka?
lines.ja: ほかには、どこに行ったんですか？
lines.kana: ほかには、どこにいったんですか？
lines.english: And where else did you go?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: sore ga ne, hoteru kara ichido mo soto ni denakatta n desu. zutto onsen ni haittemashita.
lines.ja: それがね、ホテルから一度も外に出なかったんです。ずっと温泉に入ってました。
lines.kana: それがね、ホテルからいちどもそとにでなかったんです。ずっとおんせんにはいってました。
lines.english: Well, that's the thing. I never once set foot outside the hotel. I was in the hot spring the whole time.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: e, ichido mo? jaa, omiyage mo kaenakatta n desu ka?
lines.ja: え、一度も？じゃあ、お土産も買えなかったんですか？
lines.kana: え、いちども？じゃあ、おみやげもかえなかったんですか？
lines.english: What, not once? So you couldn't buy any gifts to bring back either?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: omiyage wa, hoteru no naka de kaimashita yo. hai, kore, yuki-san ni.
lines.ja: お土産は、ホテルの中で買いましたよ。はい、これ、ユキさんに。
lines.kana: おみやげは、ホテルのなかでかいましたよ。はい、これ、ゆきさんに。
lines.english: Oh, I bought the gifts right there in the hotel. Here, this one's for you, Yuki.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: e, watashi ni desu ka? arigatou gozaimasu!
lines.ja: え、私にですか？ありがとうございます！
lines.kana: え、わたしにですか？ありがとうございます！
lines.english: What, for me? Thank you so much!

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: yuki-san mo ryokou ni iku nara, ano hoteru ni tomatte mite kudasai.
lines.ja: ユキさんも旅行に行くなら、あのホテルに泊まってみてください。
lines.kana: ゆきさんもりょこうにいくなら、あのホテルにとまってみてください。
lines.english: If you go on a trip yourself, Yuki, do try staying at that hotel.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: hai, sono hoteru ni tomatte mimasu. kondo wa watashi ga, omiyage katte kimasu ne.
lines.ja: はい、そのホテルに泊まってみます。今度は私が、お土産買ってきますね。
lines.kana: はい、そのホテルにとまってみます。こんどはわたしが、おみやげかってきますね。
lines.english: I will, I'll try that hotel. And next time, I'll be the one bringing you back a gift.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: tanoshimi ni shite imasu ne. demo, yuki-san wa, chanto soto ni mo dete kudasai ne.
lines.ja: 楽しみにしていますね。でも、ユキさんは、ちゃんと外にも出てくださいね。
lines.kana: たのしみにしていますね。でも、ゆきさんは、ちゃんとそとにもでてくださいね。
lines.english: I'll look forward to it. But you, Yuki, make sure you go outside too.

questions.ja: 佐藤さんの旅行は、どうでしたか？
questions.kana: さとうさんのりょこうは、どうでしたか？
questions.romaji: satou-san no ryokou wa, dou deshita ka?

choices.english: He went sightseeing all over Hokkaido, so he had no time to buy gifts for anyone.
He flew to Hokkaido, slept through the flight and spent the whole stay in the hotel's hot spring, but he still brought Yuki a gift.
He is just about to fly to Hokkaido, and Yuki tells him about a hotel with a hot spring.

questions.explanation: Lines 1-2: Yuki thinks he is setting off, but he has just got back (ima kaette kita n desu yo). Line 4: he fell asleep as soon as he got on the plane. Lines 6-10: he stayed at a hotel with a hot spring and never once went outside it (ichido mo soto ni denakatta), because he was in the hot spring the whole time. Lines 11-12: he bought gifts inside the hotel, and hands one to Yuki. A is wrong: he never left the hotel (line 10), and he did buy gifts (line 12). C is wrong: the trip is over (line 2), and it is Satou-san who tells Yuki to try the hotel (line 14), not the other way round.

questions.english: Yuki asks you, "ne, kondo no shuumatsu, nani suru no?" (Hey, what are you up to this weekend?) You're going away with some friends. Tell her you're going on a trip.
questions.ja: ね、今度の週末、何するの？
questions.kana: ね、こんどのしゅうまつ、なにするの？
questions.romaji: ne, kondo no shuumatsu, nani suru no?
questions.answer: Say you're going on a trip with ryokou ni iku: tomodachi to ryokou ni iku n da.

modelAnswers.romaji: tomodachi to ryokou ni iku n da.
modelAnswers.ja: 友達と旅行に行くんだ。
modelAnswers.english: I'm going on a trip with some friends.

modelAnswers.romaji: tomodachi to ryokou itte kuru yo.
modelAnswers.ja: 友達と旅行行ってくるよ。
modelAnswers.english: I'm off on a trip with some friends.

questions.explanation: You go on a trip: ryokou ni iku. Yuki asks Satou-san kore kara ryokou ni iku n desu ka? in line 1, and he answers ryokou ni itte kimashita in line 2, the shape for a trip you're back from. English 'take a trip' points to ryokou o toru, which Japanese doesn't say. In the second model, itte kuru adds 'go and come back', and casual speech drops the ni (ryokou itte kuru).

questions.english: Yuki asks Satou-san whether he flew to Hokkaido. What did he say?
questions.ja: 佐藤さんは何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: さとうさんはなんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: satou-san wa nan to iimashita ka?

choices.english: Yes, I booked a flight for the first time in ages.
choices.romaji: hai, hisashiburi ni hikouki o torimashita.

choices.english: Yes, I flew by plane for the first time in ages.
choices.romaji: hai, hisashiburi ni hikouki de tobimashita.

choices.english: Yes, I went on a plane for the first time in ages.
choices.romaji: hai, hisashiburi ni hikouki ni norimashita.

questions.explanation: Line 4: hai, hisashiburi ni hikouki ni norimashita. Being on a plane takes ni noru, like every vehicle (densha ni noru), and Yuki uses it too in line 5 (hikouki ni noru to, sugu nechau). A is 'take a plane' put into Japanese, but hikouki o toru means booking a flight, not being on one. B is English 'fly': tobu is what the plane or a bird does, and people say hikouki ni noru, or hikouki de iku for how they got somewhere, as Yuki asks in line 3 (hikouki de itta n desu ka?).

questions.english: You're about to go on a trip. Satou-san asks, "hoteru wa, mou kimemashita ka?" (Have you decided on a hotel yet?) Tell him you're staying at a hotel near the station.
questions.ja: ホテルは、もう決めましたか？
questions.kana: ホテルは、もうきめましたか？
questions.answer: Say where you'll sleep with ni tomaru: hai, eki no chikaku no hoteru ni tomarimasu.

modelAnswers.romaji: hai, eki no chikaku no hoteru ni tomarimasu.
modelAnswers.ja: はい、駅の近くのホテルに泊まります。
modelAnswers.english: Yes, I'm staying at a hotel near the station.

modelAnswers.romaji: un, eki no chikaku no hoteru ni tomaru yo.
modelAnswers.ja: うん、駅の近くのホテルに泊まるよ。
modelAnswers.english: Yeah, I'm staying at a hotel near the station.

questions.explanation: Staying the night somewhere is tomaru: Satou-san says onsen no aru hoteru ni tomatta n desu in line 6 and ano hoteru ni tomatte mite kudasai in line 14. Not hoteru ni iru, which only says where you are right now, and not hoteru ni yoru, which is dropping in on the way. The first model is the polite one for Satou-san; the second is the casual version for a friend like Kenta.

questions.english: When Yuki hears he never left the hotel, she asks if he couldn't buy omiyage either. What did Satou-san do about omiyage?
questions.ja: 佐藤さんは、お土産をどうしましたか？
questions.kana: さとうさんは、おみやげをどうしましたか？
questions.romaji: satou-san wa, omiyage o dou shimashita ka?

choices.english: He bought gifts inside the hotel to bring home, and gives one to Yuki.
He bought one souvenir at the hotel to keep for himself.
He couldn't buy any, so he asks Yuki to pick some up for him.

questions.explanation: Line 11: Yuki asks omiyage mo kaenakatta n desu ka? Line 12: Satou-san bought them inside the hotel (hoteru no naka de kaimashita) and hands one over: hai, kore, yuki-san ni. Omiyage are gifts you bring back for other people, so the one for Yuki is exactly what omiyage are for. B is the English idea of a 'souvenir' for yourself, which is jibun-you or a keepsake (kinenhin), and he gives this one away. C is wrong: he did buy them (kaimashita). Yuki promises to bring him a gift next time (line 15), but he doesn't ask her to buy anything.

questions.english: You and Yuki are staying at an inn with a hot spring. She says, "gohan made mada jikan aru ne. dou suru?" (We've still got time before dinner. What do you want to do?) Say you'll go and soak in the hot spring.
questions.ja: ご飯までまだ時間あるね。どうする？
questions.kana: ごはんまでまだじかんあるね。どうする？
questions.romaji: gohan made mada jikan aru ne. dou suru?
questions.answer: Say you'll get into the hot spring with ni hairu, plus kuru for 'go and come back': jaa, onsen haitte kuru.

modelAnswers.ja: じゃあ、温泉入ってくる。
modelAnswers.english: Then I'll go and have a soak in the hot spring.

modelAnswers.ja: じゃあ、温泉に入ってきます。
modelAnswers.english: Then I'll go and have a dip in the hot spring.

questions.explanation: You get into a hot spring the way you get into a bath, with ni hairu (ofuro ni hairu). Yuki asks onsen ni wa nando mo haitta n desu ka? in line 7, and Satou-san says zutto onsen ni haittemashita in line 10. Not onsen o abiru: abiru is for showers. Onsen ni iku would be heading off to a hot-spring town, but you're already there. Casual speech drops the ni (onsen haitte kuru); the second model is the polite version, for someone like Satou-san.

newWords.english: for the first time in a long while
not even once (with a negative: ichido mo denakatta = never once went out)
